The speeds are multiplied by it; footing is a rate its step counts are divided by. Every prerequisite sits exactly one tier lower, and the whole shape, trades included, is checked by the config build.
// Tier 1: the root. It buys a name and no movement at all, and it cannot be equipped.
// Tier 2: the two branches, one small benefit each and nothing else. Speed on one side, footing on the other.
// Tier 3: a trade per node, one larger benefit and one penalty on a stat the benefit plausibly worsens. Jump is never a penalty.
// Tier 4: every stat the tier-3 parent moves, moved the same way and further, plus exactly one new penalty.
